checked_scope: The finite convex-hull certificate and the proportional-valuation lottery construction.
checks: Minimizing squared negative part on the finite convex hull yields w>=0 and w dot z<=-||w||^2<0 when no nonnegative expected envy vector exists; the derivative sign, strict margin and nonempty-outcome hypothesis are correct.

Affine dependence removes surplus support down to q+1 envy vectors. A rational feasible polytope vertex and rational support elimination give rational probabilities, without polynomial enumeration complexity.

Descending least-load placement, including zeros, makes deletion of the last/smallest item leave load <= every other final load; all other deletions are smaller. Uniform within-component permutations remove expected envy and positive welfare weights 1/c_i certify deterministic Pareto optimality. Zero goods must follow the min-load rule.
